The Coalition has offered the Greens a six-month inquiry into plans to cut spending on the NDIS by $37.8 billion, in return for the minor party agreeing to an inquiry of the same length into the budget changes to capital gains tax and negative gearing.

The last-ditch offer has been put to the Greens by Opposition Leader Angus Taylor, but they have yet to respond. Nor have the Greens responded to multiple requests this week by AFR Weekend to discuss their intentions regarding both pieces of legislation.
